description: ADO-BATCH-SCOPE on a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID (read/write copy): S of rows 1 and 2 staged and S of row 3 set with the edit still pending; Filter = adFilterPendingRecords (RecordCount, rows); Filter "ID <= 2" (RecordCount) then UpdateBatch(adAffectGroup) (Errors, stored rows through Execute); Filter none and every row's Status and S; Filter = adFilterAffectedRecords (RecordCount); Filter none, MoveFirst, Move 2, UpdateBatch(adAffectCurrent) (Errors, stored rows); Filter "ID > 99" then UpdateBatch(adAffectGroup) (Errors). Asks which rows each scope submits, whether an unposted current edit is included and how an empty group answers.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
